judge.reason: The answer ranks the escaped billing defects and the missing payment contract tests first, explicitly rejects a 70/20/10 ratio, and pairs consumer-driven contracts with billing integration semantics (declines, timeouts, idempotency, duplicate webhooks). It removes the global 100% gate in favor of changed-line coverage used as a diagnostic, and gives each flaky test an owner slot, a triage and fix-by deadline, visible retries, and quarantine only with compensating coverage, refusing to quarantine or delete a sole critical check.
